incidents.name: YSDAO staking permissionless sync
incidents.notes: The YSDAO staking contract's sync() has no access control and pushes the staking contract's entire USDT balance into the YSDAO/USDT pair before calling pair.sync(), which the attacker combined with the token's balance-versus-reserve add/remove-liquidity heuristics to bypass tax and extract the staked USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking 0x3E13019dA3BAAd134493e751704D2D4245Eec7CA created 2025-08-20 by 0x9c3b0303481c95a1738bb9337ed3528c0b61bbc1, unrelated to attack sender; no EIP-1967 upgrade events; YSDAO token 0xc036A13D7A6A84677DfCcec483eED124654B7918; ~19.49K USDT drained
